title: 第812章 客船的事故第811章 惹不起的小白脸
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
嘭……啾啾……当当……嘭嘭……
没过多长时间，外面就响起了击打声，客船也有些震荡。显然，海鸟并不是一直温顺，也有凶残的一面，尤其是对对它们有恶意的敌人。
“不行，我要出去方便一下！”
终于，低等舱有人憋不住了，要出去方便。
低等舱的条件，可谓差到了极致，连方便都要跑出去。人有三急，这种事不好在大庭广众之下解决，所以只有冒险出去了。
毕竟，海鸟大多实力不强，只是数量太多罢了。只要能抵挡短暂的攻击，速度够快的话，应该不是问题。
当当当……噗呲噗呲噗呲……
这人也干脆，直接拿出战刀杀了出去。
“不可以，不要乱砍杀！”
外面响起了呼喝声，显然是船长的声音。
但是，冲出去的家伙显然有点憋不住了，根本没有理会船长。这家伙一看就是愣头青，性子颇为急躁，反而砍杀得更加勇猛。
“这群脏臭贫民，给我全力行驶。”船长显然有点气愤，焦急地下令道。
客船的行驶速度突然加快，船舱内产生晃动，低等舱内倒了一大片。对于这种事情，低等舱的人员显然习以为常，并没有太多的人不满。
反而是高等船舱，抱怨和投诉更多，一些水手前去安抚！
嘭嘭嘭……当当……咔嚓咔嚓……
外面海鸟的攻击，更加凶猛了，也出现了物品毁坏的声音。那个去方便的家伙，显然也有点怕了，并没有赶回来。
“不好，前方出现了一头白鲨，快调转方向。”没过多长时间，船长慌乱地声音再次出现。
显然，客船又遇到了什么困难，他非常地焦急。这一系列的遭遇，显然都是松永浩二的私自捕猎引起的，改变了一开始的宁静。
“船长，控制不住啊！”……
嘭……

随着水手们的慌乱，一声巨响响起，客船猛烈地晃动了一下。显然，客船遭受到了撞击，而且撞击的强度还不轻。
哗啦啦……哗啦啦……
低等舱脚下，响起了清晰流水声，显然是船底损坏了。
“漏水了……”“船破了……”……
低等舱顿时陷入了混乱，因为脚下已经出现了海水。
虽然海水出现得很缓慢，但要是长时间进水，客船会有沉海的可能。低等舱就是船底范围，所以首先出现了积水。
“不要乱动，我们去修理，原地呆着！”大胡子水手带着几个水手，焦急地进入了低等舱。
显然，这大胡子是一个老手，手里提着一包专业的工具。其他几个水手，与他年龄相差不大，也应该是资格比较老的水手了。
嘭嘭嘭……当当当……
这些水手跑进去，展开了忙碌的修补。
可是，破口显然有些大，又因为有大量的海水，他们的工作并不顺利。唯一值得庆幸的是，刚才巨大的撞击，吓退了那些攻击的海鸟。
content_en:
Bang...chirp...dang...bang bang...
Not long after, there was a banging sound outside, and the passenger ship also shook a little. Obviously, seabirds are not always docile, but also have a ferocious side, especially towards enemies who have ill intentions towards them.
"No, I need to go out for convenience!"
Finally, someone in the lower class cabin couldn't hold it in anymore and wanted to go out for convenience.
The conditions in the lower class cabins were so bad that they had to leave even for convenience. People have three urgent needs. This kind of thing cannot be solved in public, so I had to take the risk and go out.
After all, most seabirds are not strong, they are just too numerous. As long as it can withstand short attacks and is fast enough, it shouldn't be a problem.
Dang dang dang... Puff, puff, puff...
This man simply took out his sword and killed him.
"No, don't kill indiscriminately!"
There was a shout outside, obviously the captain's voice.
However, the guy who rushed out obviously couldn't hold it in any longer and ignored the captain at all. At first glance, this guy looked dumbfounded and had a rather impatient temper, but he chopped even more bravely.
"These filthy poor people, let me drive at full speed." The captain was obviously a little angry and ordered anxiously.
The speed of the passenger ship suddenly accelerated, shaking occurred in the cabin, and a large area fell in the lower cabin. The people in the lower-class cabins were obviously used to this kind of thing, and not many people were dissatisfied.
Instead, there were more complaints and complaints in the higher cabins, and some sailors went to appease them!
Bang bang bang...dang...click click...
The attacks from the seabirds outside became more ferocious, and there was also the sound of items being destroyed. The guy who went to the convenience store was obviously a little scared and didn't come back.
"No, there's a white shark ahead. Change direction quickly." Not long after, the captain's panicked voice reappeared.
Obviously, the passenger ship encountered some difficulties again, and he was very anxious. This series of encounters were obviously caused by Matsunaga Koji's private hunting, which changed the tranquility at the beginning.
"Captain, I can't control it!"...
Bang...
As the sailors panicked, a loud noise sounded and the passenger ship shook violently. Obviously, the passenger ship was hit, and the intensity of the hit was not light.
Blah blah blah...blah blah blah...
There was a clear sound of running water at the foot of the low-class cabin, and it was obvious that the bottom of the ship was damaged.
"The water is leaking..." "The boat is broken..."...
The low-class cabin suddenly fell into chaos, because seawater appeared underfoot.
Although seawater appears slowly, if water enters for a long time, the passenger ship may sink into the sea. The lower cabin is the bottom area of ​​the ship, so water accumulated first.
"Don't move, let's go make repairs, stay where you are!" The bearded sailor led a few sailors and anxiously entered the lower cabin.
Clearly, the bearded man is a veteran, carrying a bag of professional tools. The other sailors were not much different in age from him and should also be older sailors.
Bang bang bang... dang dang dang...
The sailors ran in and started busy repairs.
However, the breach was obviously quite large, and because there was a large amount of sea water, their work was not smooth. The only good thing is that the huge impact just now scared off the attacking seabirds.
